messages.content: Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle

reasoning:
The user wants an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle. I need to create a fun, recognizable cartoon-style SVG. Let me design it: bicycle (two wheels with spokes, frame, handlebars, seat), pelican body sitting on the seat, big beak with pouch, wing on handlebars, feet on pedals.

Let me lay out coordinates. Canvas 800x600. Wheels at (220, 450) and (580, 450), radius 90. Frame connecting. Pelican body around (400, 320), neck up to head at (480, 200), long beak extending right with pouch. Wing reaching to handlebars near (580, 340).

Let me write the SVG carefully.

Bicycle:
- Rear wheel center (220, 440) r=85
- Front wheel center (580, 440) r=85
- Crank/pedal center (400, 440)
- Frame lines: seat tube from (400,440) to (360, 330) seat; down tube from crank to head tube (540, 330); top tube from seat (360,335) to (540,335); chain stays from crank to rear wheel; fork from head tube to front wheel; handlebars from head tube up to (555, 300) with grips.

Pelican:
- Body ellipse center (330, 300), rx 90, ry 60, tilted slightly.
- Tail to left.
- Neck: from body top (370, 260) up to head (430, 160).
- Head circle (435, 150) r 30.
- Eye dot.
- Beak: long upper mandible from head to (580, 170), pouch curve below returning.
- Wing: shape from body reaching to handlebar grip (560, 305).
- Legs: from body bottom to pedals. Feet on pedal positions (400±?) pedals at crank (400,440): pedal positions (360, 415) and (440, 465) maybe. Legs drawn from (330, 350) to pedal.

Add a little motion lines and ground line.

Colors: pelican white/light gray body, orange beak/pouch, orange feet, dark bicycle frame, black tires.

Let me construct the beak: head center (445, 150) radius 28. Upper beak: path M 465 140 Q 560 135 600 150 Q 560 165 465 160 Z? Pouch: bulge below: path from (470,165) curving down to (560, 200) back to mouth. Maybe combine into a shape: upper line from (460,135) to tip (600,150), lower line from tip back through pouch curve (530, 210) to (465, 170).

Beak shape: M 455 138 Q 530 130 595 152 Q 530 205 460 172 Q 452 155 455 138 Z. That gives pouch-like lower curve.

Neck: thick path or shape: polygon from body (355, 265) up to head back (420, 175) and front (440, 185)... Use a path: M 350 270 C 345 220 380 170 425 172 L 455 185 C 430 200 420 240 400 270 Z.

Body ellipse rotated: <ellipse cx="320" cy="305" rx="95" ry="65" transform="rotate(-8 320 305)">.

Tail: path M 235 285 L 190 265 L 200 300 L 185 320 L 240 330 Z.

Wing reaching handlebars: from shoulder (390, 275) curve to grip (555, 305): path M 380 270 Q 470 250 550 300 Q 470 300 380 295 Z feather lines maybe.

Legs: leg1 from (340, 355) to pedal (355, 420): draw line stroke; foot triangle on pedal. Leg2 from (370, 350) to (450, 470). Pedals: crank arm lines from (400,440) to (355,420) and (445,460). Pedal rectangles.

Chain: line from crank to rear wheel hub small circles.

Seat at (355, 325) small black rect. Handlebar: line from head tube (540, 330) up to (550, 300), grip horizontal from (520, 300) to (565, 300)? Wing hand grips at 555,300 good.

Ground: line y=530.

Let me finalize and write the SVG with stroke widths. Ensure the pelican sits on the seat: body bottom around 360, seat at (350, 322) under body. Fine.

Draw order: wheels, frame, seat, handlebars, pedals, then pelican legs behind body? Legs should be visible; draw body then legs over frame, then beak/head, wing last over handlebar.

Write the code.

  <circle cx="580" cy="440" r="8" fill="#555"/>
  <!-- Spokes -->

  </g>
  <!-- Handlebars -->
  <line x1="520" y1="298" x2="565" y2="298" stroke="#333" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Beak with pouch -->

  <!-- Head -->

  <!-- Eye -->
  <circle cx="450" cy="145" r="6" fill="#222"/>
  <circle cx="452" cy="143" r="2" fill="#fff"/>

  <!-- Wing reaching handlebars -->
  <path d="M 375 275 Q 460 245 545 296 Q 465 310 380 300 Z"
        fill="#e0e4e8" stroke="#9aa5b1" stroke-width="4"/>
  <g stroke="#9aa5b1" stroke-width="2" fill="none">
    <path d="M 400 282 Q 450 270 500 292"/>
    <path d="M 405 292 Q 455 283 495 298"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Motion lines -->
  <g stroke="#fff" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.9">

    <line x1="70" y1="430" x2="120" y2="430"/>
    <line x1="90" y1="460" x2="130" y2="460"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Sun -->
  <circle cx="720" cy="80" r="35" fill="#ffd93d"/>
</svg>
